conditional_screen.status: Not launched by alignment phase. Freeze deterministic independent public retired roots and identical time control/color-pair protocol before any games; compare hash-only memberships to separately frozen1758 bias/follow-up starts without viewing their scores. Stop before games if no viable independent set.

correlation.definition: Pearson correlation centered separately for each compared channel/vector, restricted to entries where BOTH values are nonzero. Joint zeros, one-sided zeros, logical padding and constant vectors never supply positive evidence.

decision.fail: STOP_DIRECT_INTERPOLATION_LINE; retain actual metrics/reasons, no candidate, forced permutation, fitting or games.
decision.on_pass: One candidate only: ties-to-even (A+3*B)/4 on signed logical typed weights/biases using overflow-safe arithmetic; retain B metadata/routing/tags/padding exactly. Independent reconstruction/checksums and real standard-CI default bench/perft required before games.
decision.pass: All geometry/routing/every-stack and all FT+head gates pass.

ft_gate.scope: Every feature plane separately AND the equal-plane-weight aggregate; aggregate support is the intersection.
ft_gate.symmetries: All512 paired-lane permutations, both factor orientations. p moves raw lanes j and j+512 together; within-pair swaps are additionally tested because clipped multiplication is commutative. Report exact best assignment but never apply it.

head_gate.bias_policy: Report signed bias deltas and informative centered bias-vector correlations separately; scalar FC2 bias has no correlation and is never called an aligned vector.
head_gate.scope: FC0/FC1 logical row comparisons plus flattened FC0/FC1 and FC2 per head; every head must pass. FC0 fixed skip rows30/31 are reported individually. Padding excluded. Uninformative rows do not count as matches; insufficient support refuses gate.

sampling.global_row_filter: retain only rows with at least32 nonzero lanes and variance>=0.25 across raw lanes in each checkpoint
sampling.rank: ascending SHA256 ASCII(qinterp-alignment-v1|plane_name|decimal_local_row), within the structurally eligible geometry-only rows; first min(1024,eligible), no checkpoint-dependent resampling
sampling.structural_eligibility: PP_3Wide: distinct physical pawn squares on ranks2..7, same/adjacent files, both colors. K32H3: no back-rank pawns or nonking on the normalized own-king square; king-plane excludes adjacent other-king squares; block0 excludes rook/queen planes; block1 excludes opponent queen. FullThreats uses its already compressed native LUT row space.
